type Query = { isError: boolean; isLoading: boolean; data?: string[] };
export function project(heading: Query, details: Query) {
  const { isError: headingFailed, isLoading: headingPending } = heading;
  const failed = headingFailed || details.isError;
  const pending = headingPending || details.isLoading;
  if (failed) return { status: 'error' };
  if (pending) return { status: 'loading' };
  if (heading.data?.length === 0) return { status: 'empty' };
  return { status: 'ready' };
}
